prompt:
A THREE-PANEL horizontal strip: three equal panels in a row separated by clean cream gutters with NO drawn borders and NO frame lines. One consistent world and cast across all three panels: a woman in her fifties with warm brown skin and silver-streaked dark hair in a low bun, wearing a rust-colored cardigan over a cream blouse, at a warm wooden desk with the glowing translucent amber clamshell laptop. Camera in every panel is over-the-shoulder or high three-quarter so the face of the lit screen is genuinely visible.

BEAT ONE (left panel): the woman looks at the laptop screen. INSIDE the lit screen, a gleaming gold trophy stamped "98" stands on a small stage under two spotlight beams with drifting confetti, like an awards show. She looks mildly impressed, one hand on her chin.

BEAT TWO (middle panel): the consequence. INSIDE the lit screen the same trophy has rotated to show its BACK, which is open and hollow like a theater prop, held upright by plain wooden braces. Because the back faces the viewer, the stamped front is NOT visible in this panel. The spotlights are dimmer. The woman leans closer, eyebrows raised.

BEAT THREE (right panel): many days later at the same desk: a wall calendar dense with small pencil cross-marks hangs beside her, a worn coffee mug steams at her elbow. The woman works calmly, unhurried. INSIDE the lit screen, the small translucent clay-coral holographic mascot wearing its grand ornate gold admiral hat presents a neat, solid stack of finished pages materializing on the screen. Steady warm amber glow, no spotlights, no confetti.

Physical law: the trophy exists ONLY inside the lit screen; the mascot exists ONLY inside the lit screen and never leaves it; the woman, desk, calendar and mug exist ONLY in the real room. The laptop is an unmistakable clamshell laptop with hinged glowing screen and visible physical keyboard, never a tablet.

The woman is ABSOLUTELY NOT wearing: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, or a white tee under an open jacket. She is not a young man. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual.

Render each of these strings EXACTLY, in soft dark ink capitals, in the cream margins, never over the artwork:
- Title bar centered in the cream margin above the panels: THE BENCHMARK THAT CAN'T BE GAMED
- Caption in the cream gutter under the left panel: THE STAGED SCORE
- Caption in the cream gutter under the middle panel: PROPPED FOR THE TEST
- Caption in the cream gutter under the right panel: PROVEN BY DAILY WORK
- Footer bar centered in the cream margin below the panels: A SCORE CAN BE STAGED. A YEAR OF USE CANNOT.
- The trophy front in the left panel is stamped: 98
No other text anywhere: the calendar carries only tiny cross-marks (no letters, no numbers), the papers on the screen are blank, no writing on the wooden braces.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults

Do NOT render it in any of these styles: comic-book, cartoon mascot, flat vector, neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, photoreal, anime, any identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.

These are LOCKED canonical traits of the subject(s). They are not stylistic suggestions and must survive the render exactly: clamshell-laptop-form-with-a-visible-physical-keyboard-NEVER-a-tablet; the-WHOLE-laptop-glows-as-a-translucent-holographic-object-not-just-the-screen; glow-colour-is-the-colour-of-the-agent-supercharging-it; screen-FACE-is-visible-to-the-viewer; never-show-the-back-of-the-lid-and-the-screen-face-at-the-same-time; casts-light-not-shadow; warm-editorial-register; it-is-a-14-INCH-NOTEBOOK-33cm-wide-23cm-deep-21cm-of-screen-when-open; the-open-screen-is-about-TWO-AND-A-QUARTER-TIMES-the-height-of-a-mug-beside-it; it-occupies-about-ONE-QUARTER-of-the-width-of-a-120cm-desk-NEVER-half-NEVER-more; the-lid-is-about-ONE-AND-THREE-QUARTER-SPREAD-HANDS-wide; small-blocky-clay-coral-orange-mascot; translucent-holographic-digital-being; grand-ornate-gold-admiral-hat; gold-epaulettes; warm-rounded-dot-eyes-with-tiny-catchlights; two-stubby-legs; short-stubby-nub-arms-end-in-rounded-MITTEN-stubs-NEVER-fingers-hands-tubes-or-bars; never-LIVES-in-the-real-world-soft-crossing-allowed-only-at-delivery-leaning-through-the-screen-body-mostly-inside; never-over-anthropomorphized; never-does-task-work-only-listens-commands-delivers; warm-editorial-register-not-comic.

Colour is meaning: orange means Claude Code / the Chief of Agents is running on it; sage-green means Grantwell is; deep indigo means Storywell is. Never mix two agent colours on one machine. The ordinary, un-supercharged laptop stays a plain grey object; the glow is what marks the turn.

Identity of record is reference/chief-of-agents/master.png. Derive EVERY new pose from it (pass master as the FIRST input image), one pose per render; NEVER a multi-pose sheet in a single generation (that drifts the body composition). Keep it a SMALL blocky mascot: clay-coral Anthropic orange (~#D97757), two dot-eyes, two stubby legs, a grand ornate GOLD admiral hat + gold epaulettes (this is what makes it the Chief; sub-agents wear plain white sailor caps, no gold). Do NOT over-anthropomorphize — no big arms, no human proportions (that was the rejected creepy variant). It never does task work; it only listens, commands, and delivers. CROSSING LAW (Gary 2026-07-16, clarified same day): the Chief never LIVES in the real world; it never stands on a real desk, sits in a real chair, or walks a real room as a free-standing body. Delivery may equally be drawn as work materializing on the screen. emerging.png and delivering.png depict the soft-crossing grammar and remain canon references. LONE-AGENT LAW (Gary 2026-07-16): when a scene shows exactly ONE agent, it is the Chief.
